text:
anya: Quick follow-up from today's design review — attaching the comp and a few notes. The core issues: filter overflow, badge discoverability, and version-pin visibility. Asking for quick takes.

mike: Saw comp. On badges: tooltips won't work on mobile. We should surface short label + value inline when space allows (e.g., "latency 18ms"), and switch to an abbreviated icon+count when tight.

tara: Proposed pattern: legend row above the compare table that can collapse to an icon + "Legend" button on small widths. For filters: collapse chips into a "Filters (3)" pill that opens a bottom sheet.

sam: Implementation note: summary-pill in a table cell that reads "2 metrics" and opens a popover works cross-platform. We'll add `aria-expanded` and focus management. Also can defer some badge computation server-side to decide which badges to show.

zoe: Accessibility: avoid hover-only discovery. Legend must be keyboard-focusable; badges need aria-labels with explicit metric names. For color, use patterns not just color (icons/text) so colorblind users can parse.

anya: Version pin: current dropdown is hidden in kebab. Suggest persistent small chip on catalog header: "Pinned: v2.0.1" with quick change modal. Include scope label (org/project) and changelog link.

mike: +1 on showing scope. Also change copy from "lock" to "pin" and make confirm button "Pin version".

tara: I'll iterate two mocks: compact table with collapsible legend and mobile card-stack with inline pin affordance.

sam: I'll prototype the pill and the popover behavior, and add responsive breakpoints (<=720px cards, 720-1000px compact table).

zoe: I'll draft the a11y test cases: keyboard nav, focus return, aria-live announcements for summary content, and screen-reader-friendly changelog link.

design-bot: Mock uploaded: "catalog/compare_responsive_v1".

anya: Cool. Action items: tara mock, sam prototype, zoe a11y tests, mike to validate enterprise pin scoping with two customers. We'll review next Wed. Thanks! :thumbsup:
